The fix is commit `070fa8b` (PR #743, ticket RESTWS-1037) in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`, titled "Fix PRIVILEGE_DENIED sentinel leaks into serialized lists, causing HTTP 500." The sentinel `ConversionUtil.PRIVILEGE_DENIED` was returned for a single denied object, but collections and maps kept it as an element. The serializer then tried to write it as a `java.lang.Object`, which produced the 500. The commit makes any denied element make the whole collection or map return the sentinel, and makes the bean-property path do the same. `BasePageableResult` skips denied items in paged results instead.

I did not reproduce the visit-with-encounters request itself. The match rests on the commit message and the diff, which both describe this exact failure mode.

**Lines that implement the fix (current `HEAD`):**
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtil.java` lines 364-373: `getPropertyWithRepresentation` returns the sentinel when any collection element is denied.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtil.java` lines 397-406: the collection branch of `convertToRepresentation` does the same.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtil.java` lines 411-419: the map branch does the same.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtil.java` lines 431-434: the existing source of the sentinel, for a denied `BaseDelegatingResource`.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/DelegatingResourceDescription.java` lines 248-256: a collection-valued property returns the sentinel when any element is denied.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/BasePageableResult.java` lines 52-62: paged results skip denied items.

**Related, not changed by the commit:**
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/BaseDelegatingConverter.java` lines 150-156 already skips sentinel-valued properties when building a delegate's representation.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtilPrivilegeTest.java` is the regression test the commit adds.

I included the code spans in the array because you asked for the lines directly. That goes beyond the "change plus ticket only" rule for why/when questions.
